title_as_printed: Solubilities and Henry's constants for binary gas-water systems

value.what: x = mole fraction of the solute gas in the liquid phase; printed values are 10^4 x; pure water, so salt-free by construction

extra_unmapped: Phi_2 (fugacity coefficient of solute in gas phase, Peng-Robinson, calculated)
kH_inf GPa (Henry constant at infinite dilution, calculated from the data)

conversion_needs: value column is printed as 10^4 x: multiply by 1e-4
pressure is total pressure of the cell (gas plus water vapour); the paper gives no separate gas partial pressure column, builder would need a vapour-pressure model if partial pressure is wanted
notes: Data rows are 0-based indices among all CSV data rows after the header, including the two label rows. H2 block = rows 1-26, N2 block = rows 28-58. Temperature scale (IPTS-68/ITS-90) not stated. Table 2 (fit coefficients of Eq. 3) and Table 3 (molecular parameters) are not measured data and were not extracted.
